svg.title: Move a local coding task to Devin Cloud
svg.desc: A handoff continues a task on another computer. Use one small file change to check what arrived. Local terminal. Note the branch and add one line to a practice file. Hand off. Use /handoff to send the task to a cloud session. Cloud check. Open the file on the same branch and look for the line you added.
